evidence.t: Road: Nahwitti FSR, 4.2 km stretch.
100% of the stretch in grouse forest zones (BWBS, CWH, ESSF, ICH, IDF, MS, SBPS, SBS).
2 cutblocks touch the road (30 years old or less): edges and clover.
19 wetlands, lakes or creeks along the road: riparian edges.

plan: Drive: from District of Port Hardy, about 39 km (straight line times 1.3, estimate). Via Hwy 19 (Island Hwy), Holberg Rd.
Park: 50.70416, -127.87773, pull off on Holberg Rd (gravel road). Map links below.
Walk or drive slowly: the Nahwitti FSR stretch, 4.2 km one way. About 83 min one way at 3 km/h.
Hunt: grouse, Aug, Sept, Oct, Nov, Dec (season rows). Walk slowly in the first and last 2 hours of light. Watch where cutblocks and creeks meet the road (Tip).
Use: .22 rimfire for a sitting grouse inside 25 m (27 yd), or a shotgun with lead 6 or 7.5 (Tip).
